keyEvents.text: Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Fulham. Samuel Chukwueze replaces Alex Iwobi because of an injury.
Substitution, Fulham. Josh King replaces Emile Smith Rowe.
Substitution, Fulham. Raúl Jiménez replaces Rodrigo Muniz.
Substitution, Fulham. Antonee Robinson replaces Ryan Sessegnon.
Substitution, Fulham. Oscar Bobb replaces Tom Cairney.
